_comment: Harness project configuration. See harness-core/docs/ai-harness-architecture.md Section 9.1 and decision-log.md H-6. The review_paths field is an extension added by H-6.10 and is not in the v2.0 architecture.
_protected_paths_comment: Absolute deny. The PreToolUse hook refuses any write here. Existing platform code that Tone Test has no reason to touch, plus credentials, plus harness governance files.
_review_paths_comment: Halt and ask, rather than refuse. Three groups. The first nine are shared platform files that Tone Test must change, so a blanket deny would block the feature at build plan Task 1; edits here should be study-type dispatch only, routing to a new module, and anything larger means logic is leaking into shared code (H-6.10 control two). The docs/tone-test/ entry covers the source specification documents, which may need correcting under D-1 and D-2 but should never be rewritten without the operator seeing it. The three authentication pages were moved here from protected_paths on 24 August 2026 by the operator's decision. They were denied outright to stop Tone Test work wandering into authentication code, which remains the right default; but the operator has separately commissioned platform work on registration, email verification, password reset and the privacy policy, planned in harness-docs/PLAN-registration.md and harness-docs/PLAN-privacy-policy.md, and that work cannot proceed with them denied. Review rather than deletion, so every edit still stops for approval. If those two plans finish and no further authentication work is expected, moving them back is the safer resting state.
_review_line_budget_comment: H-6.10 control one. Guidance for the Evaluator and the operator, not enforced by the hook. An edit to a review path adding more than this many lines should be questioned.
_writable_paths_comment: New territory. Tone Test logic lives here and nowhere else.
_ordering_comment: The guard checks protected_paths first, then review_paths, then writable_paths. So harness-docs/ being writable does not weaken the specific protections above it: decision-log.md, agents/ and briefs/ are all denied because protected wins. Directory-level writability avoids editing this protected file every time a task declares a new deliverable, which would put the operator in the loop for no safety gain.
_forbidden_commands_comment: Stated explicitly because the damage is not reversible. git push origin main violates H-3.5, which reserves promotion to the operator. Force push and history rewriting violate architecture Section 14.2.
_branch_comment: H-3.5. The harness works on task branches and may merge to dev. Only the operator promotes to main.
